# Runtime-routing test evidence

Outcome: block

Files created:
- test/helpers/runtime-routing-fixture.mjs
- test/runtime-routing.test.mjs
- test/runtime-routing-schema.test.mjs

Test matrix:
- Deterministic demand derivation, exact-vector selection, trusted verification, and property-order stability.
- All closed row gates: unavailable, quality, reasoning, context, tools, skills, isolation, permissions, and observation mode.
- Full-roster producer/checker independence.
- Exact versus bounded vector-search claims.
- Comparator precedence and canonical vector-identity tie-break.
- Feasible and infeasible one-row owner overrides.
- Closed schema behavior, malformed input, published limits, public operations, and packaged schema exports.

Verification:
- PASS: git rev-parse HEAD returned 933d23209914afde8f7819291a38ffc382b91873.
- PASS: all nine declared context byte counts and SHA-256 digests matched.
- PASS: node --check completed for all three assigned files.
- PASS: git diff --check completed without findings.
- PENDING: executable tests require the V14 routing producer during integration.

Attempts:
- Attempt 1 blocked due host workspace mismatch.
- Attempt 2 used the exact isolated detached worktree at C:\tmp\swecircuit-v14-tests-agent.

Risks:
- Runtime behavior has not yet been executed against the integrated V14 implementation.
- The schema test assumes the contract's two schema-source constants use the conventional RUNTIME_ROUTING_SCHEMA_SOURCE and ADAPTIVE_RUN_SCHEMA_SOURCE names; Revision 2 requires source constants but does not state their exact identifiers.

No release-readiness claim is made.

assumptions: The integrated public package will expose the V14 operations and JSON schema package exports exactly as specified by the normative contract.
risks: Executable verification remains pending until the routing producer is integrated.
Schema-source constant identifiers are a conventional-name interpretation of an otherwise unnamed contract requirement.
followUps: Run the two runtime-routing test files after integrating the V14 routing producer and resolve any contract mismatches.
